verdict.rationale: Microsoft's support site offers feature how-to articles such as 'How to use the PC Health Check app' (relevant to upgrade readiness) and 'Turn on Live Captions', and marketing pages describe desktop features like Snap layouts, giving thin guidance on learning the interface. Nothing in the evidence shows a guided OS installation tutorial or a structured desktop-onboarding path for switchers. Missing for 10: step-by-step OS installation/setup tutorials, guided desktop-interface walkthroughs aimed at switchers, independent or hands-on corroboration of tutorial quality.
